macros.name: ebgaramond
macros.doc: Command \ebgaramond supports local use of the EB Garamond fonts.

macros.name: infigures
macros.doc: Inferior numbers (for subscripts) are available using \infigures or \textinf{...}.

macros.name: liningnums
macros.doc: Commands \oldstylenums{...} and \liningnums{...} are defined to allow for local use of old-style figures or lining figures, respectively.

macros.name: sufigures
macros.doc: Superior numbers (for footnote markers) are available using \sufigures or \textsu{...}.

macros.name: textin
macros.doc: Command \textin{...} produces decorative initials; currently only the following glyphs are available: A, D, F, G, L, N, O, Q, T and X.

macros.name: textinf
macros.doc: Inferior numbers (for subscripts) are available using \infigures or \textinf{...}.

macros.name: textsu
macros.doc: Superior numbers (for footnote markers) are available using \sufigures or \textsu{...}.
